urlParser.title: URL Parser Online — Parse & Analyze URLs Instantly
urlParser.subtitle: Free online URL parser. Break down any URL into protocol, host, path, query parameters, and fragment. No uploads, 100% private.
urlParser.description: URL Parser is a free online tool that instantly breaks down any URL into its individual components: protocol, hostname, port, pathname, query parameters, and hash fragment. Simply paste a URL and see its structure visualized in real-time.
urlParser.step1: Paste or type your URL into the input field
urlParser.step2: The tool automatically identifies and displays all URL components
urlParser.step3: Click on any component to copy it to your clipboard
urlParser.step4: Use the query parameter table to view and analyze parameters
urlParser.faq1a: URL parsing is the process of breaking down a URL string into its individual components: protocol (https), hostname (example.com), port (8080), pathname (/path), query parameters (?key=value), and hash fragment (#section).
urlParser.faq2q: Is this URL parser free to use?
urlParser.faq2a: Yes, URL Shuttle's URL parser is completely free with no limits. All processing happens in your browser — no data is uploaded to our servers.
urlParser.faq3q: Can I parse URLs with special characters?
urlParser.faq3a: Yes, the URL parser handles encoded characters (like %20 for spaces) and displays both the encoded and decoded versions of query parameter values.
urlParser.faq4q: Does the parser support all URL protocols?
urlParser.faq4a: The parser supports all standard URL protocols including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, and file:// URLs. It uses the browser's built-in URL API for accurate parsing.
urlParser.faq5q: Is my data safe when using this tool?
urlParser.faq5a: Absolutely. All URL parsing happens locally in your browser. We never send, store, or analyze any URLs you enter. Your data stays 100% private.
urlParser.cta: Try the URL Parser above — it's free and instant!

queryEditor.title: Query String Editor — Edit Query Parameters Online
queryEditor.subtitle: Free online query string editor. Add, remove, and modify URL query parameters visually. No coding required.
queryEditor.description: Query String Editor lets you visually edit URL query parameters without manually editing the URL string. Add new parameters, remove existing ones, sort them alphabetically, and encode or decode values — all with a simple interface.
queryEditor.step1: Paste a URL with query parameters into the input field
queryEditor.step2: The tool extracts and displays all parameters in an editable table
queryEditor.step3: Click on any key or value to edit it directly
queryEditor.step4: Use the buttons to add, remove, sort, or encode/decode parameters
queryEditor.step5: Copy the updated URL from the output field
queryEditor.faq1a: Query parameters are the key-value pairs after the ? in a URL. For example, in https://example.com?name=hello&age=25, "name" and "age" are query parameter keys with values "hello" and "25".
queryEditor.faq2q: Can I add new query parameters?
queryEditor.faq2a: Yes, click the "Add Parameter" button to add a new empty key-value pair. Fill in the key and value, and the URL updates automatically.
queryEditor.faq3q: How do I encode query parameter values?
queryEditor.faq3a: Use the "Encode All Values" button to apply URL encoding to all parameter values. You can also use "Decode All Values" to reverse the encoding.
queryEditor.faq4a: Yes, click the "Sort A-Z" button to sort all query parameters alphabetically by their key names.
queryEditor.faq5a: Yes, the Query String Editor is completely free with no usage limits. All processing happens in your browser for maximum privacy.
queryEditor.cta: Try the Query String Editor above — edit parameters instantly!

urlSlugGenerator.title: URL Slug Generator — Create SEO-Friendly Slugs
urlSlugGenerator.subtitle: Free online URL slug generator. Convert any text into clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs. Supports multiple separators and options.
urlSlugGenerator.description: URL Slug Generator converts any text into a clean, URL-friendly slug. Perfect for blog posts, product pages, and content management. Options include separator choice (hyphen, underscore, dot), case control, stop word removal, and max length limiting.
urlSlugGenerator.howToTitle: How to Generate a URL Slug
urlSlugGenerator.step1: Enter your text (title, heading, or any content) into the input field
urlSlugGenerator.step2: Choose your preferred options: separator, case, stop words, max length
urlSlugGenerator.step3: The slug is generated instantly as you type
urlSlugGenerator.step4: Copy the slug or preview it in a full URL format
urlSlugGenerator.faq1a: A URL slug is the part of a URL that identifies a specific page in readable form. For example, in /blog/how-to-code, "how-to-code" is the slug. Good slugs are lowercase, use hyphens, and contain relevant keywords.
urlSlugGenerator.faq2q: Why should I remove stop words?
urlSlugGenerator.faq2a: Stop words (like "the", "a", "in", "on") add length without SEO value. Removing them creates shorter, more focused slugs. For example, "how-to-build-a-website" becomes "how-build-website".
urlSlugGenerator.faq3a: Google recommends keeping URLs under 60 characters. Our default max length is 60 characters, but you can adjust it. Shorter slugs are easier to read and share.
urlSlugGenerator.faq4q: Should I use hyphens or underscores?
urlSlugGenerator.faq4a: Google treats hyphens as word separators but doesn't treat underscores the same way. For SEO, hyphens are the recommended choice. Underscores are fine for internal systems.
urlSlugGenerator.faq5a: The slug generator works with any Unicode text. For Chinese or other non-Latin scripts, it preserves the characters or transliterates them based on your browser's URL API.
urlSlugGenerator.cta: Try the URL Slug Generator above — create perfect slugs instantly!

urlValidator.title: URL Validator — Validate URLs Online
urlValidator.subtitle: Free online URL validator. Check multiple URLs at once for format, protocol, and structure issues. Batch validation supported.
urlValidator.description: URL Validator checks multiple URLs simultaneously for format validity, protocol support, port ranges, and structural issues. Paste a list of URLs and get instant validation results with detailed error messages for each issue found.
urlValidator.step1: Enter one or more URLs in the text area (one URL per line)
urlValidator.step3: Review the results table showing status and issues for each URL
urlValidator.step4: Check the summary for total valid, invalid, and warning counts
urlValidator.faq1a: The validator checks: URL format validity (using the browser's URL API), supported protocols (http, https, ftp, file), valid port range (0-65535), URL length (warns over 2048 characters), and presence of embedded credentials.
urlValidator.faq2q: Can I validate multiple URLs at once?
urlValidator.faq2a: Yes, simply enter one URL per line in the input field. The validator will check all of them and display results in a table format.
urlValidator.faq3q: What do the different status icons mean?
urlValidator.faq3a: ✅ OK means the URL is valid. ❌ Invalid means there's a format or structural error. ⚠️ Warning means the URL is technically valid but has potential issues (like being too long or using a non-standard port).
urlValidator.faq4a: All validation happens in your browser using the native URL API. No URLs are sent to any server. Your data stays completely private.
urlValidator.faq5a: The validator supports HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, and file:// protocols. Other protocols will show a warning about being unsupported.
urlValidator.cta: Try the URL Validator above — check your URLs instantly!

urlEncoderDecoder.title: URL Encoder/Decoder — Encode & Decode URLs Online
urlEncoderDecoder.subtitle: Free online URL encoder and decoder. Encode or decode URL strings instantly. Supports encodeURIComponent and encodeURI modes.
urlEncoderDecoder.description: URL Encoder/Decoder converts text to URL-encoded format and vice versa. Choose between encodeURIComponent (encodes all special characters) and encodeURI (preserves URL structure characters). Essential for handling URLs with special characters, spaces, or non-ASCII text.
urlEncoderDecoder.howToTitle: How to Encode or Decode URLs
urlEncoderDecoder.step1: Enter your text or URL-encoded string in the input field
urlEncoderDecoder.step3: For encoding, choose between encodeURIComponent or encodeURI
urlEncoderDecoder.step4: The result appears instantly — copy it with one click
urlEncoderDecoder.faq1q: What's the difference between encodeURIComponent and encodeURI?
urlEncoderDecoder.faq1a: encodeURIComponent encodes everything except letters, digits, and - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ). It's for encoding individual URL components. encodeURI preserves characters used in URLs like : / ? # [ ] @, making it for encoding complete URLs.
urlEncoderDecoder.faq2q: When should I use URL encoding?
urlEncoderDecoder.faq2a: URL encoding is needed when URLs contain spaces, special characters, or non-ASCII text. For example, spaces become %20, and Chinese characters become their encoded equivalents.
urlEncoderDecoder.faq3q: Can I encode an entire URL?
urlEncoderDecoder.faq3a: Use encodeURI for complete URLs — it preserves the URL structure (://, ?, &, #). Use encodeURIComponent for individual query parameter values.
urlEncoderDecoder.faq4a: Yes, the URL Encoder/Decoder is completely free with no limits. All processing happens in your browser for instant results and complete privacy.
urlEncoderDecoder.faq5a: Yes, the encoder handles all Unicode characters including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and emoji characters. They're converted to their percent-encoded equivalents.
urlEncoderDecoder.cta: Try the URL Encoder/Decoder above — encode or decode instantly!

urlBuilder.title: URL Builder — Build URLs Online
urlBuilder.subtitle: Free online URL builder. Construct valid URLs from individual components. Add query parameters, set protocol, host, path, and fragment.
urlBuilder.description: URL Builder lets you construct complete URLs by filling in individual components: protocol, hostname, port, pathname, query parameters, and hash fragment. The tool assembles them into a valid URL in real-time, perfect for building API endpoints or complex URLs.
urlBuilder.step1: Select the protocol (http, https, ftp, file)
urlBuilder.step2: Enter the hostname, port (optional), and pathname
urlBuilder.step3: Add query parameters using the dynamic form
urlBuilder.step4: Add a hash fragment if needed
urlBuilder.step5: Copy the complete URL or open it in a new tab
urlBuilder.faq1a: A URL builder is a tool that helps you construct valid URLs by filling in individual components separately. Instead of manually concatenating strings, you use a form-based interface to ensure the URL is correctly formatted.
urlBuilder.faq2q: Can I add multiple query parameters?
urlBuilder.faq2a: Yes, use the "Add Parameter" button to add as many key-value pairs as you need. Each parameter is automatically URL-encoded and appended to the URL.
urlBuilder.faq3q: Does the builder validate the URL?
urlBuilder.faq3a: The builder constructs the URL in real-time and uses the browser's URL API to ensure validity. If any component is invalid, the result will indicate the issue.
urlBuilder.faq4q: Can I use this to build API endpoints?
urlBuilder.faq4a: Absolutely! The URL Builder is perfect for constructing API endpoints with complex query parameters. Build your base URL once, then easily modify parameters for different requests.
urlBuilder.faq5q: Is the tool free to use?
urlBuilder.faq5a: Yes, URL Builder is completely free with no usage limits. All processing happens locally in your browser for maximum speed and privacy.
urlBuilder.cta: Try the URL Builder above — construct perfect URLs instantly!
